reviews.comment: Delivery core (port pointer, durable feed, /unknown) correct + verified; security clean. 2 blockers in the new /hub-notify.js: (1) HIGH — permission branch lacks a first-frame guard, so refreshProjects' state re-broadcast fires a spurious 'needs permission' notif+sound on every hub page load; fix: guard the claudeStatus block on pc!==undefined. (2) MEDIUM — notifications not deduped across multiple open hub tabs (no showNotification tag). Non-blocking: log-event resolveProjectRoot can throw on the hook path (use safe variant); active->idle flicker; pid-reuse; events-tab + native-hook deferred by design.

fix.comment: Fixed both blockers + 2 non-blocking. B1: first-frame guard (pc!==undefined) on the claudeStatus block -> no spurious permission notif on load. B2: stable notification tag + renotify -> dedup across hub tabs. NB1: log-event resolveProjectRoot wrapped in try/catch (never breaks the hook). NB2: 'Claude finished' now active->done only (no idle flicker). 350 tests, /hub-notify.js re-validated.

reviews.comment: Round 2 APPROVED. Both blockers fixed + verified: first-frame guard (pc!==undefined) kills the spurious permission-on-load; notification tag collapses cross-tab duplicates to one bubble. Non-blocking hook-safety (try/catch) + flicker (active->done only) also fixed. No new issues. Residual (non-blocking): multi-tab AUDIBLE dedup (renotify:true + per-tab sound) — uncommon; follow-up. Recommend a live smoke test to confirm the 'done' signal fires end-to-end. 350 tests, security unchanged.

fix.comment: Round-3 sound regression fixed: hub /hub-notify.js now plays the mp3 first (no pre-gesture short-circuit) and falls back to the richer multi-note chime matching notifications.ts

reviews.comment: Round 4: sound-regression fix restores the rich chime (== pre-N225 playTone). Discovery: mp3s are 0-byte placeholders so the chime is the real sound everywhere. Approve; empty-mp3 is a non-blocking follow-up.
Human approved after live hub reinstall; sound restored. Merge into dashboard-improvements.
